subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Bheem has been shown in the popular culture as someone **who eats in large quantity**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **eats like a horse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"eats like a horse"** means someone who eats a lot. (बहुत ज्यादा खाना खाना)
 
• **"Eats like a horse" **is an idiom used to describe someone who has a very large appetite. (बहुत भूखा होना)
 
 
• **Example: **Teenage boys often eat like horses because they are growing so fast.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **eats like a horse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eat humble pie** (नम्रता से माफी मांगना): To admit your mistake and apologize.

 
 
• **Example:** After making a wrong decision, he had to eat humble pie and apologize to the team.
 
 
 
• **Eat like a bird** (बहुत कम खाना): To eat very little.
 
 
• **Example: **She eats like a bird and often skips meals.
 
 
 
• **Chews the fat** (गपशप करना): To chat in a relaxed way, usually about unimportant things.
 
 
• **Example:** They sat around the campfire and chewed the fat for hours.
